goal: codex provider を使う docs text / docs build の {{text}} AI 生成で、timeout 後の即時失敗と partial JSON parse 診断不足を解消する。

analysis.problem: Issue #346 reports that docs text / docs build can hang during {{text}} generation with codex provider, then terminate at the agent timeout and fail with an unhelpful partial JSON parse path. The observed failure blocks documentation generation for real projects.
analysis.proposedApproach: Keep the fix inside the existing agent/provider/docs text boundaries: verify codex JSON profile behavior, make timeout failures retryable under the existing retryCount policy, and include a 200-character stdout preview in provider output or batch JSON parse failure errors.
analysis.validation: The issue identifies src/lib/agent.js, src/lib/provider.js, and src/docs/commands/text.js as the affected surface. Current context confirms codex profiles already declare --json/jsonOutputFlag, agent retry currently throws immediately for killed/signal errors, and docs text batch parsing reports only a generic parse failure after a preview log.

knownFacts: Issue #346 is linked and labeled bug.
Observed failures occur with provider codex and profile codex/gpt-5.4 during {{text}} generation.
src/lib/provider.js builtin codex profiles include --json and jsonOutputFlag.
src/lib/agent.js currently skips retry for killed or signaled subprocess errors.
src/docs/commands/text.js parses batch JSON after agent.call returns text and throws a generic batch JSON parse error on failure.
.sdd-forge/config.json sets lang to ja and docs.defaultLanguage to en.
[must] Timeout-caused codex provider failures should be retried by the existing retryCount policy.
[must] Default timeout duration changes are out of scope for this bugfix.
[must] JSON parse failure errors should include a stdout preview capped at 200 characters for diagnosis.
[must] Provider output normalization changes beyond existing codex JSON parsing are out of scope.
[must] Acceptance testing should verify timeout retry, profile JSON settings, and parse error preview without waiting for a real 300 second codex CLI timeout.
[must] docs text should preserve the existing fail-fast behavior for batch parse failure while adding the 200-character preview to the error message.
resolvedByProjectRules: [must] Do not add external dependencies; any parsing, logging, and retry changes must use Node.js built-in modules.
[must] The issue remains one spec; do not split provider, agent retry, and docs text diagnostics into separate specs.
[must] src/ must not contain project-specific paths or project-specific observed log names.
[must] Backward compatibility is required for existing CLI commands and options unless a migration plan is included.
deferredToSpec: [must] Acceptance criteria for timeout retry, 200-character partial output diagnostics, and codex JSON profile verification.
[must] Test cases for agent timeout retry and docs text parse failure messages.

in: [must] codex provider JSON output configuration verification.
[must] agent timeout retry behavior for subprocess SIGTERM timeout.
[must] diagnostics with a 200-character stdout preview for partial stdout or provider parse failure.
[must] docs text batch JSON parse failure diagnostics with a 200-character stdout preview.
[must] regression tests covering timeout retry, codex JSON profile settings, and parse error preview.
out: [must] Exclude changing public docs build or docs text command names.
[must] Exclude project-specific handling for OOS_spread_commerce paths or logs.
[must] Exclude broad rewrite of the agent provider architecture.
[must] Exclude npm publish or release operations.

impactOnExisting: [must] docs text / docs build users with codex profiles should see retry behavior on timeout instead of immediate failure.
[must] Agent failure logs and thrown errors include provider/profile context and a stdout preview capped at 200 characters when stdout exists.
[should] Claude provider JSON parsing and profile args should remain unchanged; shared retry changes may affect Claude only when its subprocess exits by timeout signal.
[must] Existing CLI options and profile keys should remain compatible.

qa.question: timeout した codex provider 呼び出しを既存 retryCount の対象にしますか？ timeout は subprocess が制限時間で SIGTERM 終了する状態です。
qa.answer: はい。timeout した codex provider 呼び出しを既存 retryCount の対象にする。
qa.evidence: Existing code pattern: src/lib/agent.js already has bounded retryCount/retryDelayMs handling; the current err.killed/err.signal branch bypasses that retry path, matching Issue #346 Short-Term Fixes item 3.
qa.why: The observed failure is a transient external subprocess timeout path, and the existing retry policy already caps retryCount at MAX_RETRY.
qa.considered: Keeping timeout as immediate failure was rejected because it preserves the reported no-retry bug.

qa.question: 今回の scope にデフォルト timeout 秒数や timeout 上限の変更を含めますか？
qa.answer: 含めない。timeout 上限は現行設定を維持し、retry と 200 文字 stdout preview の診断改善に限定する。
qa.evidence: Existing code pattern: src/lib/agent.js resolves timeoutMs from config.agent.timeout or DEFAULT_AGENT_TIMEOUT_MS, while Issue #346 Short-Term Fixes targets retry and diagnostics rather than changing that policy.
qa.why: Changing timeout duration alters runtime policy for all agent calls and is not required to fix the immediate no-retry and poor-diagnostics failure.
qa.considered: Increasing the default timeout was considered but deferred because it can hide hangs and broadens the bugfix beyond the issue's short-term fixes.

qa.question: JSON parse 失敗時の thrown error に stdout preview を含めますか？ stdout preview は、失敗した応答の一部をエラーメッセージに含める診断情報です。
qa.answer: 含める。stdout preview は先頭 200 文字に制限し、parse failure の診断に使えるようにする。
qa.evidence: Existing code pattern: src/docs/commands/text.js already logs a 200-character response preview before throwing a generic batch JSON parse error; Issue #346 asks that the thrown error also include the preview.
qa.why: The reported partial JSON parse failure needs enough response context to distinguish malformed JSON, plain text, and truncated provider output.
qa.considered: Logging only was considered insufficient because callers and test assertions see the thrown error, not necessarily the log stream.

qa.question: codex provider の出力形式そのものの正規化変更を今回含めますか？ 出力形式の正規化は、provider ごとの stdout 形式差を共通の text/usage 形式へ変換する処理です。
qa.answer: 含めない。今回の scope は codex profile の JSON 設定を固定し、既存 provider parse 契約の範囲で timeout と診断を改善する。
qa.evidence: Existing code pattern: src/lib/provider.js CodexProvider already parses codex JSON events into text/usage, and builtin codex profiles include --json/jsonOutputFlag; Issue #346 lists JSON normalization only as related context.
qa.why: A broader output normalization redesign is not necessary for the reported timeout retry and partial parse diagnostics bug.
qa.considered: Provider-wide normalization redesign was considered but deferred to the related agent_json_output proposal named in the issue.

qa.question: 実 codex CLI を長時間待つ再現テストを受け入れ条件に含めますか？
qa.answer: 含めない。受け入れ条件は automated tests で timeout retry、profile JSON 設定、parse error preview の 3 条件を確認する。
qa.evidence: Guardrail/project rule basis: project test rules require relevant regression tests, and Issue #346's observed timeout is 300000ms per call; waiting for real codex CLI timeout would make the regression suite impractical.
qa.why: The behavior can be verified deterministically with controlled subprocess/test doubles or unit-level seams without a 300 second external CLI dependency.
qa.considered: A real codex CLI 300 second reproduction test was rejected because it is slow, environment-dependent, and not suitable for default regression.

approval.notes: All draft QA entries are answered from Issue #346, project rules, or verified source context; draft coverage review passed with no unresolved user decisions.
